Subject: Finalize PO + 48h runway: action plan and billing checklist

Rahul — thanks again for the QBR yesterday. Per our conversation, Horizon is targeting a June close and procurement said they'd aim to issue a PO within 48 hours of final SOW/pricing sign-off.

Quick summary and asks so we keep the clock clean: 
- I attached the latest SOW (Horizon_SOW_v2.pdf) and a short mutual action plan (MAP) for procurement.
- Can you confirm the billing entity and a PO number format we should expect?
- Are there any remaining legal redlines we should know about (NDA/DPAs already done)?

If procurement prefers, we can accept a two-line PO referencing our Master Services Agreement + SOW. If all good, Priyom and I will lock pricing and route to finance for invoicing terms.

Proposed 48h cadence: 
1) Today: confirm billing entity + procurement contact (Rahul)
2) Tomorrow (24h): final SOW + MAP acceptance; legal to confirm no redlines
3) Within 48h: PO issued; finance sends invoice + payment instruction

I can hop on a 15-min bridge if useful — available 3:00–4:30pm PT today.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

Vivek — thanks for the summary and the SOW. Quick answers: 
- Billing entity: Horizon Health Services, Inc. (EIN ending 3421).
- PO format: "HHS-PO-2026-xxxx" — procurement will issue with that prefix.

Two quick asks from legal/procurement: 
1) Can you confirm there are no data residency clauses that require on-prem storage? Horizon's compliance team is doing a light review.
2) We have one small billing term tweak: net 45 preferred, but procurement can accept net 30 if we include standard escrow language. Can you confirm finance flexibility?

We plan to have a first-pass legal read by tomorrow EOD. If you can provide a single-line invoice sample and the invoice terms, that will speed issuance.

—Rahul

Hi Rahul — attaching a short MAP and a sample one-line invoice to make procurement life easy.

Summary of what I attached (Horizon_MAP_v1.xlsx + Horizon_SOW_v2.pdf):
- MAP: checklist with owners and ETA (rows: Contracting, Legal sign-off, PO issuance, Invoice sent, Payment received).
- SOW: final scope and usage tiers we discussed.
- Sample invoice line: "Redwood Inference — Professional Services & Inference Usage — Invoice #RW-537 — $XX,XXX"

Answers to your items: 
- Data residency: the hosted plan uses our US region; no on-prem requirement in SOW. If Horizon needs a private deployment, we can discuss Dedicated terms but that will impact lead time.
- Invoice terms: Finance has flexibility for net 45 on this deal if Procurement documents the reason. We prefer net 30 by default; please indicate if net 45 is mandatory and we'll route for approval.

Next steps (short):
1) Rahul: procurement confirms PO prefix + desired payment terms (net 30 or net 45)
2) Legal: confirm there are no redlines in SOW v2 by EOD tomorrow
3) Vivek/Priyom: finalize pricing annotation and route to finance for invoice issuance once PO is visible

Happy to jump on a quick call — proposing Tue 29 4:00pm PT or Wed 30 9:00am PT.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
